flexible_post_content.text_editor:
O3 Co-Founder and CEO Keith Scandone joined other top business leaders in The Drum’s discussion about how to prepare for the future when current events feel so chaotic. Keith pointed out that service teams are always more cognizant of future unknowns and have a leg up on planning for inevitable ebbs and flows.

Read Keith’s insights and create a better forecasting and planning strategy.
